QF.id: IV Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_41

question.text: What is the trading member-level position limit for cash-settled IRD on G-Sec in the 8-11 year maturity bucket?

answer.text: 10% of open interest or INR 1,200 crore, whichever is higher
Lower of 15% of market-wide position limit or Rs. 1,000 crore
10% of open interest or INR 600 crore, whichever is higher
15% of total open interest or Rs. 1,000 crore, whichever is higher

explanation.text: The Logic: For cash-settled IRD on G-Sec, the workbook fixes the trading-member limit in the 8-11 year bucket as 10% of open interest or INR 1,200 crore, whichever is higher. The 4-8 and 11-15 year buckets use 10% or INR 600 crore, also higher-of. The Trap: The "lower of 15% market-wide / Rs. 1,000 crore" formulation is not the workbook's G-Sec TM rule. The "15% of total open interest or Rs. 1,000 crore (higher of)" figure does appear in the workbook - but for 91-Day T-Bills and Overnight MIBOR contracts, not single G-Sec futures. The INR 600 crore floor applies to the 4-8 / 11-15 year buckets, not 8-11 year. Note: Pages 234-235 set out these category-wise position limits on a higher-of basis using open interest plus an absolute minimum, by underlying type and maturity bucket.
